title: CLTR Cutover shared reason-code vocabulary
description: The shared, closed reason_code enum frozen by PHASE_135_STAGE_3_COMPANION_SCHEMAS_AND_TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md Sec.31 ('Error and failure vocabulary'). Informational only; a reason_code never itself establishes authority, and this shared core does not verify that a code was correctly assigned for the failure that actually occurred (Layer 4). Family-local conflict_type-style enums (e.g. concurrency_conflict.schema.json's ConflictType) are deliberately NOT defined here -- each is scoped to its own owning family's future schema file.

reason_code.description: 24-value shared machine-stable reason code vocabulary. Unknown-value behavior: reject. Codes are never renamed once frozen; human explanations may be clarified in a future minor contract revision without changing the code itself.
